title: Exam OS Session Durability & Cryptographic Certificate Tamper-Proofing
objective: Harden Exam OS session state durability against accidental browser reload/disconnect, and implement SHA-256 tamper-evident cryptographic validation for issued JLPT certificates.
in_scope: Harden Exam OS session runner to persist in-flight section answers and timer state so browser refresh does not wipe exam progress.
Implement SHA-256 cryptographic hash and tamper-evident signature verification for issued JLPT N5-N1 certificates.
Verify certificate verification API (/api/certificates/verify/:certId) and QR validation metadata.
Verify with npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build.
out_of_scope: Modifying core JLPT curriculum questions or passing threshold percentages.
Altering approved subscription pricing or payment workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Exam OS in-flight answers and elapsed time persist across page reloads without state corruption.
Issued certificates generate deterministic SHA-256 verification hashes validated by public verification endpoint.
Tampered certificate payload is rejected by the verification endpoint.
Automated test script passes 100% of assertions.
Zero TypeScript errors and clean production build.
risks: Browser storage quota or sessionStorage eviction (mitigated by dual localStorage + backend session heartbeat).
